description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike Cotton Kids Hoodie - Navy
description.tagline: The comfort of Barça for the little ones
description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona Club Hoodie CE children's hoodie offers a comfortable and versatile design so that young fans can show off the Barça crest every day. Its medium-thick French Terry fabric provides softness and breathability, while the hood and kangaroo pocket provide extra comfort.
key_benefits: French Terry fabric: Comfortable, soft and breathable.
Hood: Greater protection on cool days.
Kangaroo pocket: Ideal for keeping hands warm or storing small items.
Embroidered FC Barcelona shield: Official design with quality finishes.
